$comment: Rules for check-docs-freshness.mjs (Rule R5: interface-affecting changes update the matching docs/*.md in the same PR). Human-readable version: docs/CONTRIBUTING.md §5.

rules.guidance: The OpenAPI contract changed. Update docs/API.md: conventions, the endpoint map, and any usage note that is now wrong. Also record the change in schemas/CHANGELOG.md and bump the spec version (Interface Change Protocol).

An event schema changed. Update the event table and envelope description in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §5, and note consumer impact — every consumer is idempotent on event_id (R6) and must tolerate the new shape.

The data-pack manifest or the licensing registry changed. Update docs/DATA.md §3/§4 — including the rendered registry table, which must match schemas/licenses.json (NFR-9: every bundled dataset carries its attribution).
The prompt registry changed. Update docs/PROMPTS.md (registry rules, ids in use, eval linkage). Prompt changes also require tools/ai-evals to pass its gates.

A shared package's public surface changed (src/index.ts is the public API; package.json carries name/exports/deps). Update the doc that describes that package's contract so consumers of the monorepo are not left reading a stale description.
